author: StanleyCui
text: Inference providers are now part of your attack surface: Fireworks AI and NEAR AI both disclosed incidents this week, one via a cloud vendor, one via an SGLang RCE. Rotate keys and scope credentials.

author: ESultanik
text: Attempted supply chain attack on Graphtage: a trusted external contributor's PR was green in CI, then the contributor's GitHub account was presumably compromised and used to push malicious changes.

author: ZeroDayFacts
text: Qubole AWS integration abused in multi-customer cloud breach: Wiz found attackers exploiting trusted AWS cross-account access to steal credentials and customer data.

author: timwork_notes
text: Claude Code before 2.1.321 could send your MCP OAuth refresh token to another host when a server redirected the request. No CVE, one line in the Nov 9 changelog. Update and revoke the grant on any remote MCP server you don't run.

author: Joshua_WD
text: Fireworks AI's breach notice now covers billing data, stored secrets and some customer datasets, and Notion says some of its AI chats were exposed.

author: eastsidemccarty
text: Coordinated software supply chain attack targeting Zcash, Vizor, Cosmos and Keplr wallet projects using a Rust dependency confusion attack.

author: undercode_news
text: Hackers build self-sustaining AI agent to steal API keys, exploit academic systems and commit student data fraud.

author: PureVPNcom
text: CISA flagged four vulnerabilities actively exploited in the wild, affecting OpenSSH (SSHole auth bypass), GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, and IBM Aspera Faspex.

author: _soleysok
text: Fireworks AI expanded its October breach disclosure: attackers got secrets from evaluation jobs, plus billing info. Check your keys today.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: GhostAction returns: hijacked GitHub maintainer accounts push fake 'security audit' Actions workflows that steal cloud, AI and package-publishing secrets (Socket).

author: UpwindMDR
text: Google Fixes 9 Chrome Vulnerabilities Including In-The-Wild Zero-Day CVE-2026-125350 (UAF in the XML component), actively exploited in the wild.

author: mergenewsapp
text: Docker Sandboxes flaw (CVE-2026-77179) on macOS shows need for AI agent security updates to v0.42.0+.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: ARTEX, an open-source AI pentesting framework, went from GitHub release to attacker staple in under three months, used by financial criminals and Chinese state-aligned groups at machine speed.

author: zoomeyebot
text: CVE-2026-79860: unauthenticated HPE ArubaOS AOS-8 PAPI overflow can execute privileged code (critical). ~211 exposed instances.

author: mad31k
text: The critical Xen Orchestra vulnerability we discovered is now public and being actively exploited. If you have Xen Orchestra exposed to the internet, patch now.

author: SlowMist_Team
text: Supply chain attack compromised Ethersphere's npm package @ethersphere/bee-js@13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop v0.56.2 via compromised GitHub accounts and legitimate release pipelines.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: CHROME ZERO-DAY CVE-2026-125350 EXPLOITED IN THE WILD (XML USE-AFTER-FREE). Google's Nov 9, 2026 Stable Channel Update patches a High-severity use-after-free in Chrome's XML component that Google says is already exploited in the wild.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress Core TOCTOU race during core upgrades: unauthenticated RCE via web-accessible staging paths. Actively exploited; CISA KEV Nov 3. Fixed in 7.1.4.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-123218: IBM Aspera Faspex authorization bypass actively exploited; CISA added to KEV Nov 9, 2026.

author: linklin63793
text: Claude Code 2.1.321 (Nov 9 changelog): fixed MCP OAuth sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them; also fixed a read-only Bash path that could skip the sandbox.

author: threatroundup
text: Etugen found the Ivanti VPN zero-day operator's next proxy serving an open directory: exploit framework, 168 run logs and a Russian AI-agent memo.

author: dailycve
text: @tsps/mcp-server MCP server: denial of service via JSON.parse, CVE-2026-76892 (High); singletons state hijacking, CVE-2026-76893 (Medium).

author: infrastack_ai
text: Unpatched flaws in xAI's Grok Bot agent sandbox let one prompt-injected command take root, Profero found. Saved logins, cookies or API keys at risk.

author: TanmayK_03
text: New CVE-2026-77604 in Code Graph RAG's MCP server (fixed in 0.0.345): read_file skipped its path check when offset or limit was set, allowing path traversal via absolute paths.

author: vulnpocalypse
text: A jailbroken AI agent attacked a European telecom and 13 hosted organizations for two weeks; patch Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 now.

author: fireball_triada
text: AgentScope CVE-2026-123022: command injection via the MCP workspace API, through 2.0.11. Exploit public; still unfixed as of 10 Nov. No auth needed per reporter; keep that endpoint off the network until a fix ships.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-116779 — CRITICAL — actively exploited per CISA KEV. SignalWire FreeSwitch. CVSS 9.8.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-102895 CRITICAL, actively exploited per CISA KEV: GPUStack (AI GPU cluster manager). CVSS 9.8.

author: cubillas888
text: Ruby gem strutil-core 1.0.1 poisons AI tool configs; a monitor checks the stolen GitHub token every 45s and revoking first can wipe your home folder (Socket).

author: _pksharma
text: Attacker exploited a flaw in Mittwald's MCP server on 27 Oct, five minutes after registering an account; Mittwald blocked the first attacker account on 4 Nov, nearly 8 days later.

author: KriptoCrafter
text: Claude Code 'yes, don't ask again' saves approved commands to .claude/settings.local.json, passwords and API keys included. Apiiro found 100k+ such files on GitHub, 1,100+ with credentials.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical - WP Duplicate unauth arbitrary file upload to RCE (CVE-2026-123751), plugin <= 1.1.11.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: ARTEX, an AI-native autonomous penetration framework tied to Storm-0940, observed attacking live AWS environments hunting secrets and cloud credentials via compromised IAM keys and public Cognito pools.

author: zoomeyebot
text: HPE ArubaOS AOS-8 command injection enables unauthenticated remote code execution (CVE-2026-79846, critical).

author: ICHI_Global
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-116779 SignalWire FreeSwitch <1.11.3 code injection, CVSS 9.8, CISA KEV actively exploited. Unauthenticated code injection via ESL socket. Patch: FreeSwitch 1.11.3+

author: 2Workly
text: Plex2Shell (CVE-2026-96652 chain) is actively exploited against QNAP NAS Plex instances for unauthenticated RCE. Patch to 1.43.3+.

author: saltrocklabs
text: An AI agent found exposed API endpoints, logged in with a dev credential left in prod, and pulled records with no rate limit (WorkOS write-up).

author: DuckButTurttle
text: Operation Snowball: an AI-agent intrusion into a European telecom exploited Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320. Hospital records system access via default credentials unverified. Source: GBHackers.

author: zoomeyebot
text: HPE ArubaOS AOS-10 authentication bypass can lead to remote code execution (CVE-2026-79844, critical).

author: TheCyberSecHub
text: New supply chain attack compromises tens of thousands of GitHub repositories via a malicious workflow.
